output_list.reason: The mintlvlToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set to the owner, but there is no check to prevent overflow during minting additional tokens.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The sender's balance is decreased, but there is no check to prevent overflow when the sender's balance is very high.
The lendlvlToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The lender's balance is increased, but there is no check to prevent overflow when the lender's balance is very high.
The repayLoan function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The borrower's balance is increased, but there is no check to prevent overflow when the borrower's balance is very high.
The setlvlSign function allows the owner to set the sign variable, which is a string and has no impact on the contract's functionality. This introduces a Wrong Logic vulnerability.
